tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
VSOL V1600D8 8-Port EPON OLT – High-Performance Optical Line Terminal

The V1600D8 is a powerful 8-port EPON OLT designed for fiber-optic networks, FTTH (Fiber-to-the-Home), and large-scale enterprise applications. This high-performance OLT supports advanced EPON technology, offering scalable, high-speed connectivity for service providers and telecom operators. The dual power modules (AC/DC) and hot-swappable design ensure maximum uptime and flexibility in critical network environments.

Key Features 

  • 8 EPON Ports – Supports up to 512 ONUs with a 1:64 splitting ratio per port for large-scale fiber deployments.
  • High-Speed Uplinks – 8 GE RJ45 ports, 4 GE SFP ports, and 4 x 10GE SFP+ ports for seamless and high-speed data transmission.
  • Dual Power Modules (AC/DC) – Hot-swappable design allows for easy maintenance and ensures continuous operation.
  • Compact and Efficient – 1U rack-mountable design for space optimization in data centers and network cabinets.
  • Energy-Efficient Operation – Low power consumption while providing high network performance.

Technical Specifications

  • Model: V1600D8
  • PON Ports: 8 x EPON (SFP slots, PX20++/PX20+++ compatible)
  • Uplink Ports: 8 x 1GE RJ45 + 4 x GE SFP + 4 x 10GE SFP+
  • Splitting Ratio: 1:64 per PON port
  • Backplane Bandwidth: 128 Gbps
  • Port Forwarding Rate: 89.280 Mpps
  • Power Supply: Dual AC/DC options (100–240V AC, -36V to -75V DC)
  • Power Consumption: 55W (Energy Efficient)
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to +60°C
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to +70°C
  • Humidity: 5%–95% (non-condensing)
  • Chassis: 1U 19-inch rack-mountable design
  • Weight: 4.5kg

Ideal Applications

  • FTTH / FTTP / FTTB Deployments – Provides high-speed, scalable fiber connections for residential and business users.
  • Large Enterprise Networks – Supports high-bandwidth applications with multiple uplink options.
  • Smart City & IoT Applications – Offers a robust backbone for IoT devices, sensors, and real-time monitoring systems.
  • Telecom & ISP Providers – Efficient and cost-effective for large-scale broadband service deployments.

Why Choose the V1600D8 8-Port EPON OLT?

  • Scalable & High-Performance – Supports up to 512 ONUs with multiple uplink options for flexibility.
  • Redundant Power Supply – Dual AC/DC power inputs for reliable performance in critical environments.
  • Hot-Swappable Power Modules – Easy maintenance with hot-swappable design for continuous operation.
  • Energy-Efficient – Low power consumption with high-speed data processing.
